name: Attest
rationale: Direct proof language. Every task produces verifiable evidence. The name implies certification and accountability, matching the check-based runtime.
why_creative: Moves away from flow/agent language into legal/proof territory. Strong verb that works as a command.
risk: May feel formal or compliance-heavy without product context.

name: Lattice
rationale: Graph theory without saying graph. Evokes structured coordination, mathematical precision, and interconnected nodes—perfect for DAG execution.
why_creative: Familiar word with technical depth. Avoids Flow/Graph clichés while maintaining structural metaphor.
risk: Lattice.com exists (HR software), may have trademark friction.

name: Bearing
rationale: Navigation instrument metaphor. Implies direction, precision, and knowing where you are in a complex journey—matches playbook-guided execution.
why_creative: Technical navigation term that feels calm and directional. Works well as a CLI command.
risk: Broad dictionary word; may need strong brand execution to own.

name: Cadence
rationale: Musical structure metaphor. Multiple independent agents working in coordinated rhythm, like counterpoint. Matches diverge-converge pattern.
why_creative: Premium sound, implies rhythm and reliability. Avoids AI/agent language entirely.
risk: Cadence Design Systems is a major EDA company; trademark conflict likely.

name: Seam
rationale: Weaving/binding metaphor. Where independent pieces join together. Short, concrete, and evokes careful coordination without orchestration clichés.
why_creative: Four letters, one syllable, concrete craft metaphor. Excellent CLI feel.
risk: Very short and broad; may be hard to trademark or search.

name: Gauge
rationale: Craft precision metaphor. Measuring exact tolerances, checking fit—directly maps to shell-command verification and check-based runtime.
why_creative: Technical craft term that implies measurement and standards. Avoids AI language.

name: Waypoint
rationale: Navigation checkpoint metaphor. Each task is a verified waypoint in a larger journey. Matches task-by-task convergence model.
why_creative: Clear progress metaphor without flow/pipeline language. Developer-friendly compound word.
risk: Longer (8 letters); may feel slightly generic in DevOps context.

name: Ledger
rationale: State machine and accountability metaphor. Immutable record of what ran and what passed. Matches fingerprint caching and evidence-based execution.
why_creative: Financial/blockchain-adjacent but not crypto. Implies trustworthy records.
risk: Blockchain associations may be polarizing; Ledger hardware wallet exists.

name: Span
rationale: Graph theory term (spanning tree, span of a graph). Short, technical, and evokes coverage and connection without saying graph or flow.
why_creative: Four letters, one syllable, technical depth. Excellent command name.
risk: Very broad word; may be hard to own without strong execution.

name: Rite
rationale: Ritual/completion metaphor. Each task is a rite that must be completed before moving forward. Implies ceremony and trustworthy progression.
why_creative: Four letters, unexpected semantic territory. Avoids all AI/workflow clichés.
risk: Homophone with 'right' and 'write'; may cause confusion in speech.

name: Joinery
rationale: Craft precision metaphor. The art of fitting pieces together with exact tolerances. Matches DAG assembly and multi-agent coordination.
why_creative: Woodworking craft term that implies skill and precision. Distinctive territory.
risk: Three syllables, slightly longer; may feel artisanal rather than technical.

name: Trace
rationale: State machine and provenance metaphor. Execution traces, stack traces, audit trails. Matches evidence-based verification model.
why_creative: Five letters, one syllable, technical depth. Strong CLI feel.
risk: Broad technical term; may blend into observability/APM space.

name: Plumb
rationale: Craft precision metaphor. Checking if something is true/level/correct. Directly maps to check-based verification runtime.
why_creative: Five letters, one syllable, concrete craft tool. Unexpected semantic space.
risk: Silent 'b' may cause spelling confusion; plumbing associations.

name: Canon
rationale: Musical structure metaphor. A canon is a composition where voices follow the same melody at intervals—like parallel agent execution with shared playbook.
why_creative: Premium sound, technical music term, implies authoritative standard.
risk: Canon Inc. (cameras/printers) is a major brand; trademark conflict.

name: Mesh
rationale: Graph theory without saying graph. Distributed network where nodes coordinate. Matches multi-agent DAG execution model.
why_creative: Four letters, one syllable, technical networking term. Strong CLI feel.
risk: Service mesh is a crowded infrastructure category; may blend in.

name: Signoff
rationale: Ritual/completion metaphor. Each task requires signoff before the next begins. Matches check-based gates and verification model.
why_creative: Clear completion metaphor, developer-native term (code review signoff).
risk: Two words compressed; may feel corporate or approval-heavy.
